description: List the catalog categories and the brands ALLR tracks, with the exact slugs the `category` and `brand` filters on search_gear and get_deals expect. Call this first when you are about to filter, so a filter value is grounded in the catalog rather than guessed. Cheap and static — it reads bundled catalog metadata, not the live price data.

brand_query.description: Return only brands whose name or slug contains this text (case-insensitive).

include_brands.description: Include the brand list (a few hundred entries). Set false for categories only.

name: list_categories_and_brands

includes.description: The raw product-category values this slug covers.

countries.description: Buyer countries ALLR computes landed cost for.

title: List ALLR categories and brands
